selection.description: All 270 pairs generated by the versioned Matheel IPCA filename-label adapter from the 60 labeled .txt submissions; ignore .ast files.

Matheel judged-endpoint retrieval: separate C/C++ and Java, and six scenarios per language. Use all valid judged endpoints as queries and candidates within each nonempty language/scenario. Add reciprocal relevance because source pairs are undirected, exclude self matches, and record every qrel referencing an absent file. This is not the full-corpus SOCO competition protocol.
